entries.def:
ἑκατόν, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl., 
a hundred: Mat.13.8, 23 Luk.15.4, al.; κατὰ ἑ, Mrk.6.40 εἰς, ἐν ἑ., Mrk.4.8, 20 
(AS)

ἑκατονταετής (Rec. έτης), -ές 
(ἑκατόν, ἔτης) [in LXX for שָׁנֶה מֵאָה בֵּן, Gen.17.17 * ;] 
a hundred years old: Rom.4.19.†
(AS)
a hundred times as much or many , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

ἐκ-βάλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for גָּרַשׁ pi., also for שָׁלַךְ hi., יָצָא hi., יָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to drive, cast or send out, to expel: with accusative of thing(s), mid. (σῖτον), before εἰς, Act.27.38 pass., Mat.15.17 with accusative of person(s), Mat.21.12, Mrk.11.15, al.; δαιμόνια, Mat.7.22, Mrk.1.34, al.; id. before ἐκ, Mrk.7.26 παρά, Mrk.16.9 ἐν, Mrk.3.22 (ἐν) τ. ὀνόματι, Mat.7.22, Mrk.9.38; λόγῳ, Mat.8.16…

ἔκ-βασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐκβαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.2.17; 8.8; 11.14 * ;] 
__1. a way out (Hom., Xen.): 1Co.10.13. 
__2. the issue (Menand.) Heb.13.7.†
(AS)

ἐκ-βολή, -ῆς
(ἐκβάλλω), [in LXX: Exo.11.1 (גָּרַשׁ), Jos.1.5 (ἐκβολὴν ποιεῖσθαι, טול hi.), Ezk.47.8 (יָצָא)* ;] 
__1. a throwing out. 
__2. a jettison, a throwing overboard of cargo: Act.27.18 (cf. Jos, l.with; and see Field, Notes, 144 f.).†
(AS)

ἐκ-γαμίζω 
Rec. for γαμίζω, which see: Mat.22.30; 24.38, Luk.17.27, 1Co.7.38. Not elsewhere.†
(AS)

ἐκ-γαμίσκω 
Rec. for γαμίσκω, which see: Luk.20.34-35. Not elsewhere.†
γαμίζω 
(γάμος), 
to give in marriage, a daughter: 1Co.7.38. Pass., Mat.22.30; 24.38, Mrk.12.25, Luk.17.27; 20.35 (WH, mg., γαμίσκονται; cf. γαμίζω).†
(AS)

ἔκ-γονος, -ον
(ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;] 
__1. with genitive, born of. 
__2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., a child, son or daughter; in pl., descendants: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., children or grand-children, 1Ti.5.4.†
(AS)
